parent_objective: repeat the short staged PPO escalation after M260 single-seed success

public_gates: row16 gate before full public gates
full public replay and behavior gates
forbidden_shortcuts: do not lengthen PPO beyond the M260 stage2 size
do not promote a raw checkpoint that fails protected key
do not skip interpolation boundary search
do not tune from private holdout evidence
hypothesis: The M260 4096-step staged PPO improvement is repeatable on a fresh seed if promotion remains interpolation-gated by exact source, row16, and protected-key retention.
success_criteria: fresh 4096-step PPO completes without actor input changes
raw PPO or an interpolated candidate has M223 source delta < 0, aggregate M232 delta <= +1e-8, and protected-key source delta <= +1e-8 versus M260
at least one exact-gated interpolation alpha preserves M183/M170 row16
selected candidate passes full public replay, protected-key, and behavior gates
failure_criteria: fresh stage2 PPO cannot improve exact sources
all exact-gated candidates fail row16 or protected key
selected candidate fails broader public replay or behavior gates

commands.name: m261_stage2_repeat
commands.command: Run a fresh 4096-step stage2 PPO from M260 and apply exact-source, interpolation, row16, protected-key, and behavior gates.

decision_rule: M261 may only promote a candidate if the repeated staged PPO path passes exact source, row16, protected-key, full public replay, behavior, and research-validator gates.
